QuestInfo.name: [Red Leaf High] Mission: Gym Ghost
QuestInfo.0: Find the ghosts hiding in the gym.
QuestInfo.1: #p9000128# is back! The captain of the martial arts club saw how skilled you are and wants you to join, except that he's a ghost. He's disrupting the gym classes and promises to leave when someone beats him in a match...
QuestInfo.2: #p9000128# is back! The captain of the martial arts club saw how skilled you are and wants you to join, except that he's a ghost. He's disrupting the gym classes and promises to leave when someone beats him in a match...\nYou beat #p9000128# and restored peace for the gym.

0.0: The captain ghost is back! He doesn't seem to remember losing to you. You're the only one who can take care of him. Will you help us once again?

yes.0: Careful. Unlike the other ghosts, that particular ghost is an expert with martial arts.

no.0: It'll be impossible to carry out PE classes without the gym due to the heavy rain last night.
